challenge.better_approach: Fix the resolver instead (walk refs back from the latest validate). Considered: the resolver serves hollow, verdict and sail at once and changing what it returns re-points every reader; the lane refusing makes the splice loud and the fix (--rechart) is one command. The lane is the smaller change.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That <prior>_ref is present on every chart packet: measured on 4de7's berths (decompose.survey_ref, validate.hypothesize_ref). Older berths missing a ref would read as unbroken, not red — a named gap, not a false red.
challenge.prior_art: Grepped tickets and questions: 7030e0e45338 the-claim-rides-every-link refuses a CLAIMLESS link (not a fully claimed chain from two voyages); 322ed56e5362 (PROVED) makes draft refuse over a standing validate and adds --rechart (prevents a new splice by draft, not one already standing). Neither covers this.
challenge.real_collision: None exclusive: 322ed56e5362 prevents, this detects. 529 of 1016 charted tickets carry no chart_claim.validate_berth, so absence is not refused (that would red half the corpus) — a distinction recorded, not a collision.

answers.falsifier: a fixture chain spliced from two voyages is refused at BUILDME naming the broken stage; a claim naming a validate other than the chain's is refused naming both; a coherent chain whose claim matches (or names no validate) is green.
answers.from_idea: none, because the finding was measured on ticket 4de7baf7e255 (commons eb3d02b8 records its re-chart) and directed straight to a cast by the orchestrator, not captured first
answers.how: buildme_rides_the_chart (codemother build_inspector) reads chain_for_ticket — the same resolver hollow.writes_to and the verdict read — walks orient..validate checking each stage's <prior>_ref against the standing prior berth, and compares chart_claim.validate_berth when present; one finding naming the stage whose ref breaks, or both validate berths. Red-first proof over a fixture berths root.
answers.traces_to: Law 8 — nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass: a spliced chain let 4de7's hollow measure the 09-06 plan's files, so no file of the 11-13 build could be reverted. Law 4: the chain's coherence is prose today.
answers.what: The BUILDME entry lane refuses a chart chain whose stages do not form one voyage: each standing stage must be the berth its successor's <prior>_ref names, and when the ticket's chart_claim names a validate_berth it must be the chain's validate.

bullets.text: Measured 2026-11-19 over 1016 tickets with a validate berth: 20 chains spliced (1 open: 3d796b46f449 at TICKETME), 7 claims naming a validate other than the chain's, 529 claims with no validate_berth.
